notes: Pattern search used the 64-event window cap.
Warning: Electric Guitar has no V3.4 catalogue entry. Range and Rimsky weight were not applied.
Limitation: 24 verticals place an interval of 4 semitones or less at or below MIDI 52. That low-register threshold is an engineering assumption.
Documented: loud-band weights are trumpet, trombone and tuba 2, horn 1, and woodwind 0.5. Soft-band wind weights are 1. Source: Rimsky-Korsakov, Principles of Orchestration, chapter I.
Inference: saxophone loud-band weight is 1, and each string part is weight 1. Those weights are not in the Rimsky table.
Inference: comfort ranges come from the instrument catalogue. Hard ranges are the documented sounding limits.
Inference: the melody part in a bar is the part with the highest mean sounding pitch. Ties break on duration, then part id. Unison or octave partners of that part are counted with the melody.
Inference: mf and louder map to the loud band, and mp and softer map to the soft band.

Documented vocabulary: concurrent, sequential and segmental labels follow McAdams, Goodchild and Soden, MTO 28.3. The bar-to-label rules are engineering assumptions. ORCHARD annotations were not used.
